name: DatePicker
purpose: Segmented entry and calendar selection with one coordinated popup.
useWhen: Segmented entry and calendar selection with one coordinated popup.

avoidWhen.condition: Scheduling, recurrence or remote business availability is required.

composition: A Trigger composed through asChild or render keeps the child's Button geometry; the default trigger uses compact action geometry. Calendar accepts its own seven-step size independently of input size. Keep portalled content above a parent modal and verify actual pointer selection, not only DOM presence.

Use DatePicker.Root with a stable referenceDate and an accessible name. Root and Control are divs, Label a label. Input renders Atom DateInput groups and form mirrors. Trigger is Atom Popover.Trigger, supporting its asChild/render composition. Content is Atom Popover.Content with its viewport. Calendar is the same inline Atom Calendar, never a second popup engine. ClearTrigger is a button; ValueText a span; HiddenInput mirrors multiple values only. Portal/Context add no visual wrapper.
Use date-value helpers without converting date-only values to UTC midnight.

rules.statement: Use the shared token-only radius contract only on the public parts listed in docs/guides/radius.md. Omit it to retain the owner default; do not combine it with legacy corner shape or forward it to native elements. Core names and semantic roles are distinct; popup boundaries are independent of their triggers.
Keep date behavior in Atom and presentation in Brick. Do not duplicate popup engines or replace semantic segments with text inputs.
Load styles.css or core.css plus styles/date-picker.css. Use documented visual props and locale overrides.

commonMistakes.mistake: Inventing current dates during hydration or submitting localized strings.
commonMistakes.correction: Supply stable referenceDate and typed values; preserve canonical form mirrors.

validation: Verify keyboard, locale/RTL, constraints, reset, narrow width, appearance and forced colors.
